text_en: Come on, soldier... Don't make this difficult.
How can you defy your own general? Are you no longer part of that army you so strive to save?
As you wish, I'll do myself. Be still while I free you of this suffering.
Tsk...
You're more resistant than the rest but, for me, you're no more than a worm trying to escape an apple.
This ends now.
Liandris!
Liandris, help me to trap that soldier. His strength threatens our plans.
Sangrigor? What are you talking about? What are you doing?
We must spread the Dark Plague to every corner of this world. That is our purpose.
Sangrigor, that's not you talking, it's one of the parasites.
Listen to me closely.
I see... You don't understand anything either, just like the others.
What...?
You think it's a parasite that's controlling me?_300_ That I'm doing this because I'm a puppet?
Ahahaha! You are funny...
The parasite...
Quickly, Liandris! Take it! He will show you the truth! Do it!
You have gone too far. I can no longer ask for mercy on you.
I thought you would listen to me, but I won't give up until I break your chains.
I'll be back for all of you.
Sangrigor!
Ah! There you are!
By the Gods! What on Terragaya has happened here?
Are they victims of the infection?
Quick, soldier, we must get back to Hafin. Jivan is preparing the final stages of his curative spell.  Let's take them to him.
Not so fast!
